Name: Cook Showdown - English
Author: OMEGAlinc
AuthorLabel: Mod by SmallFire translation by OMEGAlinc
Description:
English translation of Cook Showdown!


[img]https://i.ibb.co/kxFc96g/compatibility.png[/img]
Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6.14+.
Compatible with SMAPI 4.1.8+.


[img]https://i.ibb.co/ZxxPTf9/how-to-use.png[/img]
Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31794]Cook Showdown[/url].
Just install this as a normal mod, it is the full [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31794]Cook Showdown[/url] mod but edited for ALL parts to be in English.
Load Stardew Valley using SMAPI.﻿


[img]https://i.ibb.co/F4MXq8JN/thanks-to.png[/img]
